The feasible region is the shaded quadrilateral in the first quadrant, on the origin side of both lines, with corner points \(O(0, 0)\), \(A(16, 0)\), \(B(8, 12)\), \(C(0, 20)\).

| Corner point | \(Z = 22x + 18y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 0)\) | 0 |
| \((16, 0)\) | 352 |
| \((8, 12)\) | 176 + 216 = 392 |
| \((0, 20)\) | 360 |

The region is bounded, so the maximum occurs at a corner: \(Z_{\max} = 392\) at \((8, 12)\).
